description: Parse any public RSS 2.0, Atom 1.0, or JSON Feed URL into clean structured JSON items with ISO timestamps, authors, categories, and plain-text summaries. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for terms, then call again with `payment`.

limit.description: Optional max items to return (1-50, default 20).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of an RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed.

name: rss_to_json
title: Rss to json
